verdict.rationale: The docs show some pre-run steering of scope and depth. Users can pick which sources the model uses to answer (scope), and can choose generation formats that set depth, such as Deep Dive versus The Brief for Audio Overviews. These controls apply to chat and artifact generation, though, not to a documented research run with tunable effort. Missing for 10: a research-run mode with explicit depth/effort settings, the ability to steer or adjust a run while it executes, control over the scope of source discovery, and independent hands-on corroboration.
